title: Custom Plate Filling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Simport 96‑Well Plate (1200 µL) on its custom adapter in slots 2 and 5 (or 8 and 11) as Plate 1, place a second Simport 96‑Well Plate on its adapter in the remaining pair of slots, place the Opentrons 300 µL tip rack on its adapter in slot 4 (or 7), and place the Beckman Coulter 8‑Channel Reservoir (19 mL) with reagents in slot 10. The plate will be turned 90° on the deck.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If the Simport plate or its adapter is not already defined in the OT‑2 system, upload a custom labware definition file via the OT‑2 App before proceeding.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Load the generated custom plate‑filling protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.21.0 or later).

steps.title: Set protocol customizations
steps.instruction: In the customizations field, select the mount (left or right) for the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette and specify the desired transfer volume in µL.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, the reservoir, the plates, and the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette (GEN2). Use the supplied calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Run the plate‑filling protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run”. The robot will use the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette to pick up 8 or 12 tips from each column of the tip rack, aspirate the specified volume from the 8‑Channel reservoir, and dispense into the corresponding 8/12 wells of the 90‑degree‑rotated plate; it will then repeat the process with the last 4 tips to fill the remaining wells.
